Specific transfer/termination income and project partner obligations prevent a strong recurring-cash reading; project-cycle cash use alone is not misconduct or failure.

assessment.assessment: Weak realization with recurring adverse adjustments
assessment.rationale: Weak realization with recurring adverse adjustments: multi-year realization remains qualified and FY2025 cash recovery relies on substantial payable funding alongside inventory/receivable absorption. Specific transfer/termination income and project partner obligations prevent a strong recurring-cash reading; project-cycle cash use alone is not misconduct or failure.

evidence.rationale: The FY2025 recovery is real reported group cash, but advance/partner funding is not all collected handover earnings.
Project inventory and receivable cash use are funded by payables; maintenance/shared project funds have separate obligations.
Risk/reward handover and conditional one-time rental recognition prevent treating advance receipts as earned profit.
Retained verified investment-transfer and termination-income readings preclude treating all reported profit as recurring property cash.

counterevidence.rationale: FY2025 operating cash is positive and improves from the preceding year; property advances can be normal project funding. This prevents calling all cash generation fictitious or treating growth capex as a loss.
Recognition policy provides explicit performance/risk-transfer conditions; no evidence here establishes that every contract violated them.

disconfirmingEvidence: FY2025 operating cash is positive and improves from the preceding year; property advances can be normal project funding. This prevents calling all cash generation fictitious or treating growth capex as a loss.
Recognition policy provides explicit performance/risk-transfer conditions; no evidence here establishes that every contract violated them.
assumptions: No after-tax/NCI allocation or normalized FCFE is invented.
The selected band is an analytical interpretation of actual cash/adjustment evidence, not an automatic ratio threshold.
invalidationConditions: Verified project-cohort collection and recurring common-cash evidence could improve the band; material noncollection or contract revisions could worsen it.
